# Fixture sources: `fathomnet`

All files were retrieved with User-Agent `aquasource-research/0.1 (+https://github.com/torbengl/aquasource)`.
Retrieval date for the project record is 2026-10-06 (the server `Date:` headers read 2026-10-08 during the session).
Everything is served anonymously (no key, no login) by the FathomNet REST API, base `https://database.fathomnet.org/api`.
Values are exactly as served. Only whole records or whole entries were dropped, never edited. JSON was re-indented
(`json.dump(indent=1)`, key order kept); the API's own responses are minified.

The records contain `contributorsEmail` exactly as the API serves it (institutional addresses of the uploading accounts). Do not copy them into outputs.

| File | Exact URL / request | What it is / trimming |
|---|---|---|
| `api_geoimages_query.json` | `POST https://database.fathomnet.org/api/geoimages/query`, JSON bodies `{"imageLicenses":["CC0-1.0"],"limit":500,"offset":0}`, `{"imageLicenses":["CC0-1.0"],"limit":3000,"offset":120000}` and `{"imageLicenses":["CC-BY-4.0"],"limit":3,"offset":0}` | The light per-image record (keys `uuid, url, latitude, longitude, depthMeters, timestamp, imageLicense, valid, contributorsEmail, lastValidation`). 6 records: records 1-2 are CC0 NOAA NMFS SEFSC frames with `timestamp` null (1st: `761901231_Cam5.mp4`, 2nd: `SC2-camera3_03-14-21_19-57-25.000.avi`); records 3-4 are two CC0 frames 0.2 s apart of the same video `SC2-camera2_03-12-21_15-09-59.000.avi` (identical coordinate and depth, `timestamp` set); records 5-6 are CC-BY-4.0 images (folder `FN251128095328`, same coordinate 37.469, 130.828, `depthMeters` null). Note: broad `offset` paging of this endpoint is NOT stable (see the research note), so these records come from different calls. |
| `api_images_query.json` | `POST https://database.fathomnet.org/api/images/query` with `{"imageLicenses":["CC0-1.0"],"limit":3,"offset":0}` (first 2 records kept) and `{"imageLicenses":["CC-BY-4.0"],"limit":3,"offset":0}` (first 2 kept); `GET https://database.fathomnet.org/api/images/list/all?size=2&page=0` (first record kept) | The full image DTO with `boundingBoxes` (each with `annotationLicense`) and `tags`. 5 records in this order: 2 CC0 (NOAA drop-camera frames, `imagingType` "Drop Camera", with `depthMeters`, 2-3 boxes with Latin `concept` names), 1 CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 (Schmidt Ocean Institute ROV frame with CTD fields and a FathomVerse tag; must map to Excluded), 2 CC-BY-4.0 (the 1st has `latitude`/`longitude`/`depthMeters` all null, a 224x224 plankton crop from `oer.hpc.msstate.edu`, to test the no-coordinate path; the 2nd has coordinates, same as record 5 of the file above). |
| `api_counts.ndjson` | 9 requests in this order: `GET https://database.fathomnet.org/api/images/count`; then `POST https://database.fathomnet.org/api/geoimages/count` with `{"imageLicenses":["<L>"]}` for L = CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-NC-4.0, CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0; then the same four with the added whole-world box `"minLatitude":-90,"maxLatitude":90,"minLongitude":-180,"maxLongitude":180` | One raw JSON response per line, unmodified. They give: 481,126 images in total; per licence 231,631 / 7,948 / 635 / 240,912 (sum = total, so only these four licence values occur); and the georeferenced counts 231,631 / 16 / 595 / 235,347. |
| `licenses_list_excerpt.json` | `GET https://database.fathomnet.org/api/licenses/list/all` (16,388 bytes, 77 licences) | Dropped to 7 entries: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-NC-4.0, CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0, JPL-image, NIST-PD. Shows the licence vocabulary (SPDX ids in `spdxId`, flags `selectableForImages` / `selectableForAnnotations`). The route name was found in the web app bundle `https://database.fathomnet.org/fathomnet/assets/index-BWeHvTyV.js`. |
| `api_imagesetuploads_excerpt.json` | `GET https://database.fathomnet.org/api/imagesetuploads/list/all` (paged with `page` and `size`; 350 uploads in total over 4 pages of 100) | Dropped to 3 uploads: NOAA NMFS SEFSC `GFISHER 01 of 13`, Schmidt Ocean Institute `FK190726 ... S0282 Part 1`, and one CENCOOS "Planktivore" upload. The `darwinCore` block carries the upload-level licence text, `rightsHolder`, `ownerInstitutionCode` and `collectionCode`; `remoteUri` is the per-upload CSV zip. |
| `licence.txt` | `https://www.fathomnet.org/terms` (page says "Last updated: 2025-01-12") and `https://www.fathomnet.org/datause` | Text extracted from the HTML (tags stripped; one sentence can be split over several lines because of inline markup) and cut to the paragraphs on licences, ML-training use, account registration, acknowledgement and "benevolent use". |

Other things read but not stored as fixtures (all small or Range-limited):

- `GET https://database.fathomnet.org/api/stats/list/contributions` (1.3 KB): per-institution image totals.
- `GET https://database.fathomnet.org/api/images/list/imagingtypes` (`["Drop Camera","ROV"]`) and `.../images/list/contributors` (11 accounts).
- `GET https://database.fathomnet.org/api/geoimages?size=3000&page=10&sort=uuid` (and page 11): stable paging, light records, 1.2 MB each.
- The fathomnet-py 1.10.2 wheel from PyPI (30 KB, read only, never executed) to learn the route names.
- The NOAA Google Cloud bucket: `HEAD`/`Range: bytes=0-1023` of one frame (206), the JSON listing `https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/nmfs_odp_hq/o?prefix=nodd_tools/datasets/gfisher/&delimiter=/`, and a 2.5 KB `Range` of `gfisher_fathomnet.csv` (header `concept,image,x,y,width,height,groupof`).
- One per-upload CSV zip (`https://database.fathomnet.org/static/archive/scott.brown_at_noaa.gov__20260203T202048.279Z.csv.zip`, 530,932 bytes): it contains only `boundingboxes.csv` (no coordinates).
- NOAA InPort `https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/inport/item/30062` and `.../29502` (access / use constraints), and Crossref for DOI 10.1038/s41598-022-19939-2.
